# History rewrite (2026-11-10)

Before the repository went public, its history was rewritten once with `git filter-repo` to
remove private details: the author's personal email address (commits now carry a GitHub
noreply address), a home-folder path, the coding assistant's working notes and a review
handoff (removed from every commit), and personal attribution wording (neutralised in every
version of the files that had it; see the editorial note at the end of
`docs/prereg-anthropic.md`). Commit dates and the order of commits are unchanged. No
registered content of any pre-registration changed, and every config hash is unchanged.

The original history is kept as a git bundle with sha256
`f365dc7831569148068c9fe4c4dfacf248f92ad9339608c97d5e444db81a39ab`, so any pre-rewrite
version can be produced and checked against that hash.

**Commit hashes.** Every commit hash changed. Hashes cited in the docs and in commit messages
were updated to the new ones. Episode records (`runs/*/episodes.jsonl`, not in the
repository) store `git_sha` values from before the rewrite; map them with the table below.
One commit, `aaee2ce`, touched only the removed working notes and no longer exists; its
content is that of `2b63543`.
